name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtrationObs_succ_eq_filtration
doc:
**Trivial observations carry no information.** With `𝓞 = Unit` the σ-algebra generated by the
first `n + 1` rounds together with the observation at time `n + 1` is the round filtration
`filtration n`: the observation component of the pair is constant, so it contributes nothing.

This is what lets a conditional distribution given `(history, obs)` — the form of the upstream
`IsAlgEnvSeq.hasCondDistrib_action` — be read as a conditional expectation given the history
filtration.

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg env P

code:
/-- **Trivial observations carry no information.** With `𝓞 = Unit` the σ-algebra generated by the
first `n + 1` rounds together with the observation at time `n + 1` is the round filtration
`filtration n`: the observation component of the pair is constant, so it contributes nothing.

This is what lets a conditional distribution given `(history, obs)` — the form of the upstream
`IsAlgEnvSeq.hasCondDistrib_action` — be read as a conditional expectation given the history
filtration. -/
lemma filtrationObs_succ_eq_filtration {𝓨 : Type*} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨}
    {alg : Algorithm Unit 𝓐 𝓨} {env : Environment Unit 𝓐 𝓨}
    (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg env P) (n : ℕ) :
    h.filtrationObs (n + 1) = h.filtration n
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtrationObs_eq_comap, filtration_eq_comap]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [← measurable_iff_comap_le]
    exact (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl).prodMk (measurable_const (a := ()))
  · rw [← measurable_iff_comap_le]
    exact measurable_fst.comp (measurable_iff_comap_le.mpr le_rfl)

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.condExp_feedback_stationaryEnv
doc:
**Conditional expectation of the feedback is the mean of the arm's reward kernel.**
Under a stationary environment with per-arm reward kernel `ν`, the conditional expectation of
the response `Y n` given the action-augmented filtration `filtrationAction n` is the mean
`ν.means (A n)` of the chosen arm's reward distribution. This is the `g = id` case of
`condExp_feedback_comp_stationaryEnv` (equivalently, the upstream `condExp_feedback` with
`means_stationaryEnv`).

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg (stationaryEnv ν) P

statement.conclusion: P[Y n | ↑h.filtrationAction n] =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ν.means (A n ω)

code:
/-- **Conditional expectation of the feedback is the mean of the arm's reward kernel.**
Under a stationary environment with per-arm reward kernel `ν`, the conditional expectation of
the response `Y n` given the action-augmented filtration `filtrationAction n` is the mean
`ν.means (A n)` of the chosen arm's reward distribution. This is the `g = id` case of
`condExp_feedback_comp_stationaryEnv` (equivalently, the upstream `condExp_feedback` with
`means_stationaryEnv`). -/
lemma condExp_feedback_stationaryEnv (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg (stationaryEnv ν) P) (n : ℕ)
    (hint : Integrable (Y n) P) :
    P[Y n | h.filtrationAction n] =ᵐ[P] fun ω ↦ ν.means (A n ω)

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.memLp_feedback
doc:
**The response is in `L²` as soon as every arm's reward distribution is** (the paper's
Condition **A**). With finitely many arms the second moments `∫ x² dν a` have a finite maximum,
and the response's conditional law given the chosen arm is `ν (A n)`; so an `L²` hypothesis on
`Y` need not be assumed alongside `hνk`.

The conditional law of `Y n` given the action `A n` is `ν (A n)` at every time
(`IsAlgEnvSeq.hasCondDistrib_feedback_stationaryEnv`).

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg (stationaryEnv ν) P

code:
/-- **The response is in `L²` as soon as every arm's reward distribution is** (the paper's
Condition **A**). With finitely many arms the second moments `∫ x² dν a` have a finite maximum,
and the response's conditional law given the chosen arm is `ν (A n)`; so an `L²` hypothesis on
`Y` need not be assumed alongside `hνk`.

The conditional law of `Y n` given the action `A n` is `ν (A n)` at every time
(`IsAlgEnvSeq.hasCondDistrib_feedback_stationaryEnv`). -/
lemma memLp_feedback [Finite 𝓐] (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg (stationaryEnv ν) P)
    (hνk : ∀ a, MemLp (fun x : ℝ ↦ x) 2 (ν a)) (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (Y n) 2 P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite 𝓐
  -- A uniform bound on the arms' second moments.
  set C : ℝ≥0∞ := ∑ a : 𝓐, ∫⁻ y, ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂(ν a) with hCdef
  have hone : ∀ a : 𝓐, ∫⁻ y, ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂(ν a) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro a
    have hfin := (hνk a).integrable_sq.hasFiniteIntegral
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm] at hfin
    refine ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_of_eq ?_) hfin)
    exact lintegral_congr fun y ↦ by rw [enorm_pow]
  have hC : C ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hCdef]
    exact (ENNReal.sum_lt_top.mpr fun a _ ↦ (hone a).lt_top).ne
  have hb : ∀ a : 𝓐, ∫⁻ y, ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂(ν a) ≤ C :=
    fun a ↦ Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a ↦ ∫⁻ y, ‖y‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂(ν a))
      (fun _ _ ↦ zero_le) (Finset.mem_univ a)
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Y n) P := (h.measurable_feedback n).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact memLp_two_of_hasCondDistrib hC (h.hasCondDistrib_feedback_stationaryEnv n) hmeas hb

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.condExp_feedback_comp_stationaryEnv
doc:
**Conditional expectation of a function of the feedback given the history and the action.**
Under a stationary environment with per-arm reward kernel `ν`, the conditional
expectation of `g (Y n)` given the action-augmented filtration `filtrationAction n`
(the history up to `n-1` together with the current action `A n`) is the integral of `g`
against the chosen arm's reward distribution, `∫ x, g x ∂(ν (A n))`. This is the crux behind
the response martingale (and its quadratic variation): the fresh randomness of a step is the
response, revealed *after* the arm is chosen. This is the upstream `condExp_feedback_comp`
(whose kernel is `env.feedback n` applied to the history, the observation and the action) with the
stationary environment's feedback kernel `ν.prodMkLeft` read off.

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg (stationaryEnv ν) P

binders.name: hint
binders.type: MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => g (Y n ω)) P

statement.conclusion: P[fun ω => g (Y n ω) | ↑h.filtrationAction n] =ᵐ[P] fun ω => ∫ (x : ℝ), g x ∂ν (A n ω)

code:
/-- **Conditional expectation of a function of the feedback given the history and the action.**
Under a stationary environment with per-arm reward kernel `ν`, the conditional
expectation of `g (Y n)` given the action-augmented filtration `filtrationAction n`
(the history up to `n-1` together with the current action `A n`) is the integral of `g`
against the chosen arm's reward distribution, `∫ x, g x ∂(ν (A n))`. This is the crux behind
the response martingale (and its quadratic variation): the fresh randomness of a step is the
response, revealed *after* the arm is chosen. This is the upstream `condExp_feedback_comp`
(whose kernel is `env.feedback n` applied to the history, the observation and the action) with the
stationary environment's feedback kernel `ν.prodMkLeft` read off. -/
lemma condExp_feedback_comp_stationaryEnv (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O A Y alg (stationaryEnv ν) P) (n : ℕ)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : StronglyMeasurable g) (hint : Integrable (fun ω ↦ g (Y n ω)) P) :
    P[fun ω ↦ g (Y n ω) | h.filtrationAction n] =ᵐ[P] fun ω ↦ (ν (A n ω))[g]
proof:
:= by
  refine (h.condExp_feedback_comp n hg hint).trans ?_
  filter_upwards with ω
  rw [feedback_stationaryEnv, Kernel.prodMkLeft_apply]
